newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmenistan has Jan-Nov $400 mln trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan has Jan-Nov $400 mln trade surplus.

text.p: Turkmenistan had a trade surplus of $400 million in the first 11 months of last year, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.

But excluding countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States, which accounted for 51 percent of Turkmenistan's total foreign trade, the Central Asian state had a deficit of $353.4 million, the committee said.
It provided detailed data for trade with non-CIS states only:
